## Secutest Development Status Report

### Current Status (GEO-10)

**Phase 1: CI Verification** — ✅ Complete
- Push to origin/main succeeded (commit `7c6a624`)
- CI pipeline currently **running** on GitHub Actions: https://github.com/ghoulrip/Secutest/actions

**Current CI Jobs:**
| Job | Command |
|-----|---------|
| `frontend-test` | `npm test` (39 tests, 98.8% coverage) |
| `frontend-lint` | `tsc --noEmit` |
| `frontend-security` | `npm audit --audit-level=high` |
| `backend-build` | `cargo build --release` |
| `backend-test` | `cargo test` + fmt + clippy |
| `backend-security` | `cargo audit` |
| `docker-build` | Multi-stage Docker image |

**What was fixed:**
- GitHub 100MB file limit blocker (removed `backend/target/` from history)
- Authentication for push (GitHub credentials resolved)

**Remaining Work:**
- **Phase 2:** Fix Windows local development (`dlltool.exe` not found) — unblocks local testing after CI passes
- **Phase 3:** Expand test coverage (integration/E2E tests, coverage reporting)
- **Phase 4:** Production readiness (CI badges, timing metrics)

**Next Action:** Monitor CI run at https://github.com/ghoulrip/Secutest/actions. Once CI passes green, backend tests will be validated on Linux (the critical gate).

**Key Finding:** Local Windows toolchain is broken (missing `link.exe` and broken MinGW linking), but Linux CI is unaffected — the CI run will validate the backend tests never ran locally.
